tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by words (garment, breed, colour, mood, gift idea). Typos are corrected.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Facts about one product: price, colours, sizes, materials, description, stock, link, image.

tools.name: shipping_and_returns
tools.description: Where the shop ships, delivery times, free-shipping threshold, returns and policy links.

tools.name: size_guide
tools.description: The product's real size chart in cm (garment half-chest and length), and a size pick when the shopper's chest (and height) or EU shoe size are given. Same chart and rule as the product page.

tools.name: delivery_estimate
tools.description: Earliest and latest delivery date if ordered today, and the shipping price options, for one or more products together (pieces from different print facilities travel as separate parcels).

tools.name: product_link
tools.description: A link that opens the product page with the given colour and size already chosen.
